permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Reads the tmux panes your muxway token may see and sends the answers you confirm on the glasses to the hub you set on the phone.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Records what you say when you choose Say it on a pane, and sends that clip to your muxway hub for transcription. Recording starts only on that action and stops when you tap, cancel or leave.
